comments.headline: Townhome units use incorrect addressing schema
comments.summary: The 39 townhome units are not addressed per City of Austin Addressing Standards: units should receive individual street addresses based on their entrance locations (Figure 4), not a shared address with unit numbers; additionally, unit numbering omits required floor-level designators (Figure 2).

details.text: All 39 townhome units assigned to shared address (3759 Valley View Road) with unit numbers (101-806) instead of separate independent main street addresses. Per Addressing Standards Figure 4, attached townhomes with street-facing front doors must each receive own primary street address based on entrance location.

runComments.comment: Cannot verify whether attached townhome units with front door access directly to the street have been assigned separate independent main street addresses per Addressing Standards Figure 4. Current addressing shows units at a shared address (3759 Valley View Road, Unit 101-806) rather than individual main street addresses. Requires clarification from applicant and City of Austin 911 Addressing Division review confirming whether Figure 4 or Figure 2 schema applies and has been approved.

Townhome units are assigned as interior unit numbers (101-806) at a shared address (3759 Valley View Road) using a Building# + Unit## schema. Per Addressing Standards Figure 4, attached townhome units with street-facing front door entrances must each be assigned a separate, independent main street address based on their entrance location along the street range. Townhome units must not be addressed using unit numbers at a shared address. Each townhome unit must receive its own primary street address from the Addressing Division.

Townhome units have not been assigned separate independent main street addresses based on their entrance location per Addressing Standards Figure 4. All 39 units are currently addressed to a single shared address (3759 Valley View Road) with unit numbers (101-104, 201-206, etc.). For townhomes with street-facing front doors, each unit must receive its own separate primary street address, not unit numbers at a shared address.

details.text: Unit numbering uses Building# + Unit## format (e.g., 101, 102, 201, 202) but omits required floor-level designators. Addressing Standards Figure 2 requires Building# + Floor# + Unit## schema for multi-building developments.

runComments.comment: Unit numbering schema cannot be verified as compliant with Addressing Standards Figure 2 (Building# + Floor# + Unit##). Current numbering shows Building# + Unit## (e.g., 101-104, 201-206) but lacks floor designators. For multi-building developments, Figure 2 requires floor numbers in the unit designation. Requires confirmation of which addressing schema applies and City of Austin 911 Addressing Division approval documentation.

Unit numbering does not follow the Building# + Floor# + Unit## schema required by Addressing Standards Figure 2 for multi-building developments. The current plan shows Building# + Unit## numbering (e.g., 101, 102, 201, 202) but lacks floor-level differentiation within the numbering structure.
